content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect multiple [product_name] operator panels to a single [product_name] module? I understand that all panels would display the same message, but that's actually what we want for our application.
No, this isn't supported. The module can only communicate with one operator panel.

However, you could set up a network with two modules and transfer value inputs and outputs from module 2 to module 1 as VM values. This way, you can show the values from module 2 on module 1's operator panel.
[user_name], that was also my second idea. But considering cost, it might be better to use one [product_name] controller with a [product_name] panel. Thanks for your input.

Hi, I think this setup may work. Settings would be: Module IP x.x.x.1, Panel 1 IP: x.x.x.2, Panel 2 IP: x.x.x.3. Both panels communicate with the module at x.x.x.1. I believe it's possible because the [product_name] module has a dynamic server function. You should try it out and see.
Based on the manual, the module should only communicate with a single operator panel. Is this statement in the manual perhaps incorrect?
As soon as I have a second operator panel available, I’ll test this configuration and share the results here.

Some features aren't documented for various reasons. What should be expected if more than one panel were supported? Ideally, each panel would show different messages or be configured individually, but that's not possible. If you just need a duplicate display, it might work in limited scenarios. That's probably why it's not officially documented.

analysis.insight_summary: The thread discusses whether multiple [product_name] operator panels can be connected to one [product_name] module, noting conflicting information between user experience and documentation. Users highlight that, even if technically possible, both panels would only show the same content, with no option for individual messaging. There is confusion due to incomplete documentation about these setups, and users are seeking confirmation for mirrored applications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking to connect multiple operator panels to a single module with identical messages displayed, and want clear, official guidance on whether this is possible.
